Draw the equivalent circuit and power flow diagram of induction motor. A 10   
50kW, 440V, 50Hz, 6 pole induction motor has a slip of 6% when operating at   
full-load conditions. At full-load conditions, the friction and windage losses are   
300W, and the core losses are 600W. Find the following values for full-load   
conditions:   
(i) The shaft speed ηm   
(ii) The output power   
(ii) The load torque τload   
(iv) The induced torque τind   
(v) The rotor frequency

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2020
